title: Opinions within Media, Power and Gossip
review_status: full-text audit complete; model setup and nonlinear simulation results checked; real-world causal effect not evaluated
sections_checked: §1.2 model grounding and Italian campaign context
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2011-02-11; journal/conference publication not verified
evidence_note: 100 simulated agents, 100 turns, 10 repetitions per scenario. P2P partly inhibits media under low tolerance, but at tolerance 0.5 and media reach above 70% the simulated P2P interaction amplifies the fixed media message; a 30% unreached group changes outcomes. Experts are assumed truthful; no causal voter study is reported.

title: Contribution to the Formal Specification and Verification of a Multi-Agent Robotic System
review_status: full-text audit complete; safety/liveness model checking and model-to-simulation case study checked; finite scope and future code-generation work recorded
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2015-10-02; paper text identifies a service-oriented simulation implementation
evidence_note: Checks a finite stock-transport model with two carrier agents and nine road partitions for safety/liveness, collision/deadlock, and stock conservation; maps specifications to C# robotics simulation. No physical hardware deployment; model adequacy and complete deployment code-generation remain outside demonstrated evidence.

title: Personal Universes: A Solution to the Multi-Agent Value Alignment Problem
review_status: full-text audit complete; classified as conceptual proposal; core value-extraction assumption and unresolved measurement/psychology concerns checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2019-01-01; peer-reviewed venue not verified
evidence_note: Proposes personalized simulated worlds as alternative to merging values. Explicitly assumes value extraction is solved and excludes assessing value-extraction methods; discusses unresolved measures of whether values are served and psychological risks. No empirical evaluation.

title: Multi-Agent Optimization for Safety Analysis of Cyber-Physical Systems: Position Paper
review_status: full-text audit complete; position-paper status, preliminary FMECA/AMAS model scope, missing inputs, and future work checked; no empirical safety effect
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2024-03-25; paper explicitly labels itself a position paper
evidence_note: Preliminary model covers only cost and two of four preventive-action/failure relation types; timing constraints and fuller model remain future work. Authors state FMECA tooling lacks information/calculation support needed to realize solution directly. No end-to-end benchmark or CPS safety evaluation reported.

title: Testing, Validation, and Verification of Robotic and Autonomous Systems: A Systematic Review
review_status: citation follow-up publisher record/abstract checked; full article inaccessible in this session and not counted as full-text audit
sections_checked: publisher abstract and reported search/coding scope

evidence_note: Abstract reports 10,735 studies screened and 192 included/coded; identifies missing rigorous efficiency/effectiveness/adequacy metrics, limited industrial applicability evidence, and missing consolidated benchmarks.
